source_row.society: International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology
source_row.extraction_instructions: Server-rendered single-page calendar; list_shells_override reads only the 'Upcoming events' tab (#tab-upcoming-article-list, ~19 cards, count checked against the page's 'N events found'); the Past tab is lazy-loaded history and ignored. Listing date is canonical (a detail page once had a typo'd year); detail supplies end date, time, fees, CME, venue. Two detail shapes: ISUOG Approved Courses (free-text, organiser registration link, rare Venue/Course fee lines) and ISUOG Education webinars/livestreamed courses (Registration section with GBP fee table, Early Bird vs Standard columns; free webinars say 'free to attend'). Education items tagged 'UK' in the listing are organiser location, not event location.

registry_comment: ISUOG — static events calendar (upcoming tab only), approved courses + education webinars/livestream courses, GBP fee tables

spot_check.site_says: Members £294, Non-members £385, 8 categories, Standard from 29 Sep 2026
Malmö, SWEDEN, Skane University Hospital, MKC ...
spot_check.extractor_says: venue as printed; city Malmö; region Sweden

concerns: Recon said ~76 events; the site's Upcoming tab holds 19 (the 76 included past events). World Congress 2027 (Lisbon) is not yet on the calendar, so it is not in the shells.
Non-GBP fee: Malmö course fee is SEK; tier carries currency SEK with the VAT-inclusive total. Confirm the frontend handles SEK (conventions list GBP/USD/EUR/HKD/SGD/CHF/BRL only).
Fee table category labels are kept as printed, so the two Spanish Education courses have Spanish category names; their prices are GBP.
Early-bird columns whose deadline has passed are dropped; with the 'Standard price from <date>' column treated as current.
Most Approved Courses state no fee on the ISUOG page (registration is on the organiser's site), so pricing is [] for them. booking_url is set to the external registration link when one is found.

Specialty is the constant 'Obstetrics & Gynaecology' (society remit, same convention as rcog.py); description is LLM with first-paragraph backstop. The LLM returned 429 for a few calls during testing and the backstop was used.
Education pages print ISUOG-London as CME location; treated as online (livestreamed), so venue/city/region are None for them. The one hybrid course (Apr 2027) has no venue on the page.
Only the Upcoming tab is read; I did not check whether the lazy-loaded Past tab ever holds future-dated items.
